name: Monimonikkusu
source: This game is an animation omnibus ADV that uses the new animation system "Moni Moni System" exclusively for Windows 95. It contains two short stories: "Private Tutor" and "Horse Racing The Lover", both are made using full animations.
translation: 这是一部动画短篇合集式冒险游戏，专为Windows 95打造，采用全新的“Moni Moni System”动画系统。收录《Private Tutor》和《Horse Racing The Lover》两个短篇，均使用全动画制作。
